additional_info.subject: ID0453188-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R3 170001699] Black Screen Issue CRM:03056000106
additional_info.body:
Dear Bart,
I hope that you are well.
Please measure the Voltage between the 24V supply on the PCB.
1) If the Voltage is between 24/25V and the HMI is not Ok
2) Verify if the DP cable is properly attached.
3) If both are OK then replace the HMI.
Best Regards,
Marcelo
